content.text:
good morning — hope the coffee is still warm.

it looks like this is a quiet week on all fronts. there are no upcoming health check-ins flagged right now, no milestones surfaced this stage, and nothing new in the local village to flag. that's genuinely a calm stretch — nothing slipping through the cracks, just a week to breathe.

if anything ever feels overdue — a well visit, a developmental question, a local group you've been meaning to check out — your pediatric office and your local parks-and-rec page are always good first calls.
